final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT p.SEX AS c1, AVG(CAST(l.CPK AS REAL) / l.GPT) AS c2 FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.SEX <> '' GROUP BY p.SEX), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(c2) AS c1 FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.c1 AS c1, s1.c2 AS c2, s1.c2 - s2.c1 AS c3 FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.c1 IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.c2 > s2.c1), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(c2) AS c1 FROM s3), s5 AS (SELECT s3.c1 AS c1, s3.c2 AS c2, s3.c3 AS c3, s3.c2 - s4.c1 AS c4 FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.c1 IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.c2 > s4.c1) SELECT AVG(c2), AVG(c3), AVG(c4) FROM s5
